newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania to double participation to EBRD capital.
newsitem.headline: Romania to double participation to EBRD capital.

text.p: Romania will double to some $114 million its participation to the capital of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, the government said.

"The measure was taken to match the size of EBRD loans given to Romania, which ranks third among the countries which benefited from the bank's funds," government spokesman Eugen Serbanescu told a news conference at the weekend.
He said Romania previously contributed 48 million ECU ($57 million) to the EBRD capital.
EBRD loans of more than $900 million -- including $600 million with state guarantees -- have been used for projects in transport, communications and energy over the past four years.
